candidates.vehicleIdentity: 2006 Audi TT quattro Sport | OY06ZZL | 77,000 miles | £11,490 | Snippersgate
candidates.location: Houghton-Le-Spring, Tyne and Wear, United Kingdom
candidates.note: Rechecked 23 Sep 2026 against the highest-authority Snippersgate seller advert and the matching PistonHeads cross-post. OY06ZZL remains actively offered by the seller at £11,490, 77,000 miles, 2006, manual, Silver Metallic with Phantom Black roof, and is explicitly described as the limited-edition TT quattro Sport 240. The seller page exposes active Enquire, Reserve and finance controls and records six previous owners. An exact current seller exterior image was inspected with no SOLD, RESERVED, DEPOSIT TAKEN or UNDER OFFER overlay. This run could not positively identify an exact current cabin/gear-selector frame from the seller gallery, so the mandatory manual-photo gate remains incomplete. Keep verification-pending; it is also weaker on mileage/ownership than the current DU06FRC best-of-class TT and should not replace it.
